title: Documents Study Guide
text: This resource is intended to help you read through through the various documents in the JSMP. It is not prepared by legal scholars or subject matter experts. It is a volunteer-led guide meant to be used in tandem with your own critical analysis. The intended purpose of this page is to serve as a primer before you sit down and read the details of any of the documents listed below. Finally, this study guide is only a glimpse into the breadth of the extensive final report.
